NEW TO THE MARKET
Ballindrimley, Castlerea, Co. Roscommon
Eircode: F45 XN65
Exceptional Three-Bedroom Detached Bungalow

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are delighted to present to the market this exceptional three-bedroom detached bungalow, which can only be described as one of the finest properties to come to the Castlerea market in recent times.

Finished to showhouse standard throughout, this impressive residence is presented in immaculate condition and offers prospective purchasers the opportunity to acquire a truly walk-in home where attention to detail and quality finishes are evident throughout.

The property enjoys an excellent location within walking distance of Castlerea town centre, with the benefit of footpath access and street lighting, while the beautiful Castlerea Demesne Park is also within close proximity.

The residence is connected to mains water and mains sewage and benefits from PVC double-glazed windows and doors together with external lighting.

ACCOMMODATION
Entrance Hall
Welcoming entrance hall featuring tiled flooring, coving and feature lighting.

Sitting Room
An impressive and beautifully presented living space featuring a solid-fuel stove with cream timber surround and granite hearth, coving, feature lighting and dado rail.
The room is further enhanced by solid oak doors, architraves and skirting boards together with fitted plantation-style interior window shutters, creating an elegant and luxurious finish.

Kitchen / Utility Area
Beautifully finished cream fitted kitchen complemented by marble worktops, gas hob with electric oven, extractor fan and traditional Belfast sink.
Additional features include coving and a PVC door providing convenient access to the garden.

Dining Room
Bright and spacious dining area featuring tiled flooring, coving, fitted curtains, bay window and fitted plantation-style interior window shutters.
The room also provides access to the hot press and additional storage.

Snug
A comfortable additional living space featuring tiled flooring, coving and solid oak doors, architraves and skirting boards.

Bedroom One
Well-presented bedroom featuring fitted carpet, coving, solid oak doors, architraves and skirting boards together with fitted plantation-style interior window shutters.

Main Bathroom
Beautifully finished main bathroom with fully tiled floor and walls, white vanity unit with mirror and shaving light and a large fully tiled walk-in electric shower.

Bedroom Two
Spacious bedroom featuring fitted carpet, fitted wardrobe, coving, solid oak doors, architraves and skirting boards together with fitted plantation-style interior window shutters.

Bedroom Three
Well-proportioned bedroom featuring fitted carpet, fitted wardrobe, coving, additional storage and solid oak doors, architraves and skirting boards.
Ensuite
Fully tiled ensuite featuring WC, WHB with mirror and shaving light and a fully tiled electric shower.

OUTSIDE
The exterior of the property is every bit as impressive as the residence itself.
A tarmac driveway extends to the front and side of the property, providing excellent access and ample off-street parking.

The property is complemented by attractive block boundary walls with ranch-style panel fencing and beautifully maintained mature gardens to the front, side and rear.

An additional area of ground to the side of the property may offer further development potential, subject to the necessary planning permission being granted.

A stone gravel area to the side provides additional parking, while to the rear of the property is a workshop with electricity connected, an enclosed rear garden, fuel shed and attractive patio area.

The extensive gardens surrounding the property have been exceptionally well maintained and feature mature hedging, colourful shrubbery and flowers, creating a private and attractive outdoor setting.

KEY FEATURES
• Exceptional three-bedroom detached bungalow
• Finished to showhouse standard throughout
• Presented in immaculate walk-in condition
• Excellent location within walking distance of Castlerea town centre
• Footpath access and street lighting to Castlerea
• Convenient to Castlerea Demesne Park
• Beautiful fitted plantation-style interior window shutters
• Quality solid oak doors, architraves and skirting boards
• Cream fitted kitchen with marble worktops and Belfast sink
• Solid-fuel stove with cream timber surround and granite hearth
• Three bedrooms with ensuite to Bedroom Three
• Additional snug offering a second living space
• Mains water and mains sewage connected
• PVC double-glazed windows and doors
• Tarmac driveway with ample off-street parking
• Mature landscaped gardens to the front, side and rear
• Workshop with electricity connected
• Enclosed rear garden with patio area and fuel shed
• Additional area to the side offering potential for further development, subject to planning permission
• External lighting
